decisions.reason: The testimonial instruction is an unresolved insertion marker. The passage provides no material below the final sentence, so the location claim was changed minimally. The marker alone does not establish an assistant-to-requester relationship.

The proposed profile and first-person decision to assume an unsupported year establish a drafting voice. The source instruction is both an unresolved marker and a revision instruction in that context.
The opening-date instruction is an unresolved marker. The surrounding bakery notice supplies no assistant-to-requester relationship for a wrapper label.
The map-link instruction is an unresolved marker in the reading-room notice. Its bracketed form alone does not establish a requester-directed wrapper.
The meal-total instruction is an unresolved marker. The surrounding report contains no drafting voice or requester address.
The venue-address instruction is an unresolved marker. The surrounding event notice contains no separate assistant-to-requester framing.
The meter-reading instruction is an unresolved marker. The passage otherwise reads as a resident update, with no established requester relationship.
The accessibility-statement instruction is an unresolved marker. The surrounding clinic notice does not establish that it addresses a requester.
The future collection-point instruction is an unresolved marker. Three current points and a proposed fourth are consistent; the passage contains no assistant-to-requester framing.
The writer announces an unsupported dating decision after describing a missing record. That drafting voice makes the source instruction a revision instruction as well as a placeholder.
The model identity and verification limit leak into the tourism copy. The instruction to check hours before release addresses the drafting process and remains unresolved.
The reference to a generated handout makes the capability statement drafting commentary. The fasting instruction is an unresolved insertion and revision instruction.
The writer substitutes an unsupported prize detail because results are unavailable. In that drafting context, the verification marker is also a revision instruction.
The writer selects a specific date despite lacking the schedule. The instruction to confirm that date is an unresolved marker and a revision instruction.
The phrase 'through this draft' makes the expertise limit drafting commentary. The source insertion directs revision of that draft.
The writer announces an unsupported biographical addition. The appointment-verification marker directs revision in the same drafting context.
The writer announces a specific completion date despite lacking the schedule. The approved-date marker is an unresolved revision instruction.

The draft mentions a weight limit that it does not provide, so the clause was made conditional. The first-person testing limit remains drafting commentary, and the load-rating marker directs revision.
The writer announces an unsupported survey figure after saying the results were unavailable. The citation marker directs revision in that drafting context.
